title: Find the Encrypted String
summary: Given a string s and an integer k, for each character in s, replace it with the character that is k positions ahead in the string, wrapping around if necessary.
statement: Given a string s and an integer k, for each character in s, replace it with the character that is k positions ahead in the string, wrapping around if necessary. Return the modified string.
constraints: Replace each character at index i with the character originally k positions to its right, wrapping around.
hints: The replacement source for index zero is index k modulo n.
Following sources continue contiguously through the end and wrap to the prefix.
Thus concatenate s[k:] with s[:k] after reducing k modulo length.
This sequence lists source indices k,k+1,... modulo n exactly once in destination order.
editorial: This sequence lists source indices k,k+1,... modulo n exactly once in destination order.

tests.explanation: Indices read t,d,a,r after shifting three, producing tdar.
Every shifted source is a, so the string is unchanged.
